title: Graph-chart divergence formula: T(ω) = ∫_{G⁻¹(E)} div Φ_ω for the vector field Φ_ω of G^#ω (supplied steps 0–1)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, N, E ⊆ ℝ^P, ξN : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P a linear isometry with adjoint ι*, u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and δ₁, δ₂ ∈ ℝ. Write D := B_{δ₁}(0) ⊆ ℝ^{n+1}, G(v) := x + ιv + u(v), DG(v) for the derivative of G at v, e_0, …, e_n for the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1}, j.succAbove for the increasing enumeration of {0, …, n} ∖ {j}, and J(v) := (det[⟨ιe_i + Du(v)e_i, ιe_k + Du(v)e_k⟩]_{i,k})^{1/2}. Assume: E is Borel, E ⊆ N ∩ U, and T(ω) = ∫_E ξN(w)(dω(w)) dH^{n+1}(w) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN); δ₁ > 0 and δ₂ > 0; u is C² on D; for every v ∈ D: u(v) ⊥ range ι, ‖Du(v)‖ ≤ 1, |u(v)| < δ₂/2, G(v) ∈ N, and ξN(G(v))(α)·J(v) = α(ιe_0 + Du(v)e_0, …, ιe_n + Du(v)e_n) for every (n+1)-covector α; and whenever |v| < δ₁, |h| < δ₂, h ⊥ range ι and x + ιv + h ∈ N, then h = u(v). Let Z := {w ∈ ℝ^P : |ι*(w − x)| < δ₁ and |w − x − ιι*(w − x)| < δ₂}. Let ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ Z, and let Φ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{n+1} be Φ(v) := Σ_{j=0}^{n} (−1)^j ω(G(v))(DG(v)e_{j.succAbove 0}, …, DG(v)e_{j.succAbove(n−1)})·e_j for v ∈ D and Φ(v) := 0 for v ∉ D. Then Φ is C¹ with compact support, tsupport Φ ⊆ D, and T(ω) = ∫_{D ∩ G^{-1}(E)} trace DΦ(v) dL^{n+1}(v).
